description: This script manages authentication directories and files for a Docker-based environment related to OpenClaw. It includes functions to trim strings, normalize directory paths, determine inclusion based on provider names, collect directories and files from CSV inputs or overrides, and join CSV strings.

methods.name: openclaw_live_trim
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_normalize_auth_dir
methods.description: Normalizes a directory path, prepending '.' if necessary.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_dir_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the authentication directory name for a given provider.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_file_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the authentication file name for a given provider.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_csv
methods.description: Collects unique auth directories from a CSV list of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth directories based on override environment variable settings.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs
methods.description: Determines auth directories to use, prioritizing overrides.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_csv
methods.description: Collects unique auth files from a CSV list of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth files based on override environment variable settings.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files
methods.description: Determines auth files to use, prioritizing overrides.

methods.name: openclaw_live_join_csv
methods.description: Joins multiple string arguments into a comma-separated CSV string.
